places.people: Cultural centre collective with residents and guests
places.who: Artists, activists, residency guests, local youth
places.vibe: Avant-garde rural culture house with a big garden: regular residencies, workshops and happenings, feminist and self-organised, east of Berlin.

places.name: Coliving Frilingue
places.people: Up to 22 guests across two chalets
places.vibe: Alpine chalet coliving with cooking together and the Swiss Nomad Fest. Earn-your-stay places from 2 weeks; shared rooms from about 530 euros for 28 nights.

places.name: Savi Coliving
places.vibe: Mountain house, sober by design: goal setting, skill shares and accountability check-ins. About 1,200 euros a month all-inclusive.

places.name: Franz and Mathilde
places.vibe: Mountain coliving above Bolzano, May to September: group hikes, shared meals, movie nights. From about 1,390 euros a month.

places.name: Coliving Semkovo
places.vibe: Low-cost mountain coliving from about 500 euros a month, still ramping up.

places.name: Arctic Coliving
places.vibe: Adventure lodges in Henningsvær and Voss; from about 72 euros a night shared, with discounts for longer stays.

places.name: Silveira Tech
places.people: Village in the making on 220 ha
places.vibe: Regenerative village project replanting 220 ha of burnt hills; village building just starting.

places.name: Gaarawe
places.vibe: Riverside bamboo-hut ecovillage between two national parks, with an open-air cinema (2015 report).

places.name: Can Masdeu
places.people: 24 adults and 5 children; about 100 people at Sunday open days
places.vibe: Squatted former leper hospital in the hills above Barcelona since 2001: terraced community gardens, Sunday open house with tours, workshops and a 5-euro vegetarian meal, a metro ride from the city.
places.region: Night run: big volunteer communities and hubs

places.name: Ecodharma
places.vibe: Wild Pyrenean retreat centre joining meditation and ecological action; solitary cabins; team roles posted when open.
places.region: Night run: big volunteer communities and hubs

places.name: Rishikesh
places.vibe: The yoga capital on the Ganges: ashrams, kirtan, teacher trainings and many work-exchange hostels.
places.region: Night run: big volunteer communities and hubs

places.name: Tiruvannamalai
places.vibe: Quiet pilgrimage town under Arunachala; ashrams and long silent stays, two hours from Auroville and Sadhana Forest.
places.region: Night run: big volunteer communities and hubs

places.name: Lake Louise ski resort and Fairmont jobs
places.who: Working holiday makers, many Australians and Kiwis
places.vibe: Winter and summer seasons with staff housing: lifts, snowmaking, rentals, hotel and kitchen roles in the Rockies.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Sunshine Village jobs
places.vibe: On-mountain resort above Banff with staff housing options, winter and summer.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Marmot Basin and Jasper jobs
places.vibe: Staff housing guaranteed for winter and offered for most summer roles (Sky Tram); winter 2027 hiring opens 1 November.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Whistler Blackcomb and hotel jobs
places.vibe: The biggest ski town scene; resort and Fairmont, Four Seasons and Westin roles placed with housing through agencies.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Big White jobs
places.who: Working holiday makers on IEC visas
places.vibe: Late November to mid-April; free season pass and lessons; on-mountain staff housing offered but not guaranteed; bring about 3,000 Canadian dollars to start.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Twin Anchors houseboats
places.vibe: Houseboat holidays on Shuswap Lake, April to September; private room with shared bathroom; dock, guest and housekeeping roles.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Last Frontier Heliskiing
places.vibe: Remote lodge 360 km north of Terrace, mid-December to mid-April, with staff housing: save hard, deep snow.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Okanagan cherry harvest
places.who: Young travelling pickers, many from Quebec
places.vibe: Cherry season peaks in July around Kelowna and Oliver; pickers often camp on the orchards.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Las Palmas crew hunt (ARC)
places.vibe: Boat-hiking season November to February; the ARC leaves twice in November and once in January. Most boats arrive crewed, so come early, use oceancrewlink.com, or volunteer on the ARC minibus to meet skippers.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Bark Europa
places.people: Up to 42 voyage crew plus permanent crew
places.who: Voyage crew of all ages, no experience needed
places.vibe: Tall ship where guests sail the ship on watches. 2027: Namibia (April) to the Azores, La Rochelle, Bordeaux and Scheveningen, about three months in all, any leg.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Palma de Mallorca crew hub
places.vibe: The Mediterranean's main hiring port for yacht and delivery crew, roughly April to October.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Antigua, English Harbour
places.vibe: Caribbean season hub, roughly December to April, where transatlantic boats land and crews change.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Tres Hombres cargo sailing ship
places.vibe: Engine-less brigantine carrying cargo under sail across the Atlantic; trainees join legs.
places.region: Night run: seasonal work and sailing

places.name: Roskilde Festival 2027
places.who: Huge international volunteer community, music lovers
places.vibe: 26 June to 3 July 2027. Northern Europe's biggest non-profit festival, built largely by volunteers; sign up and they contact you when volunteer registration opens.

places.name: Nowhere
places.vibe: Europe's Burning Man regional, usually early July (2027 dates not out yet). About two-thirds of people volunteer; build crews get early entry and strike crews stay on. Bring all your own food and water.

places.name: Ozora Festival 2027
places.who: Psytrance and visionary art crowd from around the world
places.vibe: A week-long gathering in the Hungarian countryside about 140 km from Budapest; estimated 23 July to 3 August 2027; ask the organisers about helper roles.

places.name: Shambala Festival
places.people: Arts and music festival at Kelmarsh Hall
places.vibe: Late-August bank holiday weekend. Volunteer on the gates through My Cause UK: three 8-hour shifts, crew camping and a meal token per shift; 200-pound deposit and a 30-pound donation.

places.name: Shambhala Music Festival 2027
places.who: Electronic music and arts crowd, volunteer crews
places.vibe: Listed for 23 to 26 July 2027 on a Kootenay farm. Volunteers give 40 hours (set-up, gates, fire safety, clean-up) for free entry and three meals a day; paid crew roles too.

places.name: Burning Man 2027
places.vibe: 29 August to 6 September 2027. Volunteer teams (build, gate, art) run the city; check burningman.org for roles and ticket sales.

places.name: Oregon Country Fair 2027
places.vibe: 58th fair, 9 to 11 July 2027, in the woods west of Eugene; volunteer crews apply through the 2027 applications page.

places.name: Bhakti Fest
places.who: Kirtan singers, yogis, devotional music lovers
places.vibe: Yoga, dance and sacred-music festival held in Joshua Tree since 2009; the closest festival to the Krishna Village sound. Dates TBA.

places.name: Buinho Creative Hub
places.vibe: Village residency with a FabLab, textile lab and Precious Plastic workshop; 2 weeks to 2 months at 900 to 1,300 euros a month, with free weekly tutorials. 2027 call closed 21 August 2026; watch for 2028.
places.region: Night run: residencies, language exchange, housesits

places.name: Saari Residence (Kone Foundation)
places.who: Artists, writers, composers, curators of any nationality
places.vibe: Manor residency in the southwest Finnish countryside: two-month periods with a monthly grant of 2,700 to 3,800 euros, plus ecology excursions and mentoring. The 2027 deadline has passed (31 March 2026).
places.region: Night run: residencies, language exchange, housesits

places.name: VaughanTown
places.country: Spain (villages near Madrid, e.g. Barco de Ávila)
places.people: Groups of about 10 Spaniards and 14 English speakers
places.who: Native English speakers of all ages, Spanish professionals
places.vibe: Six days of one-on-one conversations, walks and evening events in a rural hotel; free room and three meals, you pay your own travel. No Spanish allowed.
places.region: Night run: residencies, language exchange, housesits

places.name: UK housesitting hotspot
places.who: Housesitters, solo or as a pair
places.vibe: The strongest market for TrustedHousesitters, plus HouseSitMatch and House Sitters UK: weeks of quiet study time with a dog for company.
places.region: Night run: residencies, language exchange, housesits

places.name: France housesitting hotspot
places.who: Housesitters, solo or as a pair
places.vibe: Nomador's home ground (about 1,400 European sits), plus MindMyHouse; country houses for long, inward stretches.
places.region: Night run: residencies, language exchange, housesits

places.name: Spain housesitting hotspot
places.who: Housesitters, solo or as a pair
places.vibe: Good coverage on MindMyHouse and HouseSitMatch; winter sits in the south pair well with Alpujarra stays.
places.region: Night run: residencies, language exchange, housesits

places.name: Mexico housesitting hotspot
places.vibe: Its own platform, HouseSitMexico; expat areas like Lake Chapala have steady sits.
places.region: Night run: residencies, language exchange, housesits

places.name: Tree planting camps, northern Ontario
places.vibe: Gentler ground than BC, so the usual pick for first-years; May to mid or late July, 3 or 4 days on and 1 off; Brinkman rookies averaged about CA$225 a day in 2025

places.name: Tree planting camps, Alberta foothills
places.vibe: Projects within about three hours of Edmonton in the foothills and Rockies, near Miette Hot Springs; season May to late July or August, paid per tree

places.name: Coronet Peak and The Remarkables (NZSki) jobs
places.vibe: Early June to mid-October; most roles open around March; free 3 Peaks pass, transport and lessons; only limited staff housing. Australians need no visa to work in NZ

places.name: Mt Hutt (NZSki) jobs
places.vibe: Same NZSki winter season and perks as Queenstown, in a small farming town under the Southern Alps

places.name: Niseko ski season jobs
places.vibe: International ski schools (Niseko United, Rusutsu, Kiroro nearby) and hotels hire English speakers; resort-run jobs like lifts want Japanese. Japan's working holiday is age 18 to 30, once only

places.name: Hakuba ski season jobs
places.vibe: Alpine valley with international ski schools such as Evergreen and many foreign-run lodges

places.name: French Alps seasons (Tignes, Val d'Isère and more)
places.who: Working holiday makers with some French
places.vibe: Hospitality, childcare and shop jobs at minimum wage; high resorts run longest; instructor, patrol and lift tech jobs need French qualifications. French working holiday open to Australians to 35

places.name: Acheninver Hostel, live-in season
places.vibe: Remote wild-coast hostel: free live-in room, £13.50 an hour, 10am to 3pm six days a week, roughly May to September; needs UK work rights (Youth Mobility visa works)

places.name: Champagne grape harvest (vendanges)
places.who: Pickers from across Europe, travellers on working holidays
places.vibe: Often starts in late August, the earliest French harvest; short, hard, communal work at minimum wage, finishing with harvest meals

places.name: Beaujolais grape harvest (vendanges)
places.vibe: Hand-harvested Gamay in September; the biggest picker demand in France, so the most open door for a working holiday

places.name: Bordeaux grape harvest (vendanges)
places.vibe: Later harvest that can run into October as Cabernet ripens; pairs with Champagne and Beaujolais for a six-week harvest trail

places.name: Kiwifruit packhouses, Te Puke
places.vibe: Main season mid-March to June, a second packing season mid-July to November (Apata); needs an IRD number and NZ bank account, no visa for Australians

places.name: Glastonbury 2027 volunteer crews
places.who: Festival lovers working for a free ticket
places.vibe: Back after the 2026 fallow year. Oxfam stewards do 3 shifts of about 8 hours for free entry, a crew campsite, showers and food vouchers; WaterAid and Greenpeace crews too. Applications open early in the year and fill fast; refundable deposits

places.name: Antibes yacht crew hub
places.vibe: Do the 5-day STCW Basic Safety Training (about €1,295 here or in Palma) and an ENG1 medical, then dockwalk in spring; a small-yacht deckhand or stew job posted at €3,000 a month. Non-EU crew are limited by Schengen's 90 days, and the US season needs a B1/B2 visa

places.name: Yukon exploration camps (core cutter, field tech)
places.vibe: Banyan Gold's AurMac project posted a core cutter contract 1 March to 15 November 2026: day rate plus production and season bonuses, camp room, board and travel paid, 2-on-2-off or 3-on-2-off; needs Canadian work rights (IEC works), a Class 5 licence and Level 1 first aid. A direct match for NSW field tech experience

places.name: BC exploration field technician (Blackwater)
places.country: Canada (central BC, southwest of Prince George)
places.vibe: Artemis Gold posted an exploration field technician role at CA$41.73 an hour, 2 weeks on and 2 off at a remote camp: core logging, cutting and sampling for diamond and RC drilling

places.name: DOC hut warden rangers, Fiordland
places.people: A ranger or two per hut
places.vibe: Live in a Great Walk hut from October to about May, 8 days on and 6 off, salary band NZ$61,189 to 67,446; staff quarters provided, bring your own food and bedding; needs a full NZ licence. Australians need no NZ visa

places.name: Amagi Village
places.vibe: A family-friendly eco-village being built on Koh Phangan for living, working and education, run on a venture-builder model; named by Agartha as a possible Creativity Incubator host

places.name: The Leela Centre (formerly Osho Leela)
places.vibe: Shared vegetarian meals, jam sessions, dance and creative workshops; new volunteers start with a 7-night induction for £75, then free if it fits; also a paid Living in the Buddhafield programme. Town-level pin

places.name: Buddhafield Festival crews
places.people: Up to 1,000 volunteers a year across events
places.vibe: Alcohol- and drug-free festival of music, dance, crafts, yoga and meditation; build crews worked 35 to 37 hours over 5 days for admission and meals in 2026. Pin is approximate, not the site

places.name: Schweibenalp
places.people: Up to 30 community members plus volunteers
places.vibe: Alpine spiritual community and permaculture centre: 6 hours a day, 5 days a week for food and lodging, with a CHF 120 first-month contribution; 30-day minimum (60 for permaculture)

places.name: PachaMama
places.vibe: Forest eco-village with dance, music and art nights; 6-week minimum, 4 to 5 hours a day, lunch and dinner included; camping US$2 a night December to April, but two paid workshops are required

places.name: International People's College
places.vibe: English-language residential folk high school: global studies, music, arts; spring 2027 runs 19 January to 5 July for DKK 56,688 including room, meals and excursions. A different way into a big friendly cohort

places.name: European Juggling Convention 2027
places.people: Thousands of jugglers and circus people
places.vibe: A week-long participatory circus gathering of workshops, shows and camping; 2027 awarded to the Azores (island, venue and dates not yet confirmed, so the pin sits at Ponta Delgada). Espinho, Portugal for 2028

places.name: Rancho Mastatal
places.vibe: Natural building, tropical agriculture and fermentation workshops plus longer residential programmes; work trades are limited and skill-based

places.name: Greenpop Reforest Fest
places.vibe: Four days of tree planting, music, workshops and camping; the next edition points to 2028 and volunteer applications are closed for now

places.name: InanItah Water Season (AquaNitah)
places.vibe: 15 February to 15 August each year: plant-based meals, music jams, movement and gardening; newcomers pay US$450 a month for 15 service hours a week, meals and camping. Pin is approximate
